summary: A local paid-trial decision sheet and commission tracker are ready for the post-interview written terms. Every commercial and access field remains pending, no unagreed historical range is recorded as compensation, and no work or external action is authorized.
verification: The decision sheet covers scope, exclusions, effort cap, compensation, dates, invoicing, payment, acceptance, access, confidentiality, ownership, and portfolio use.
The commission tracker contains one pending trial row with all unagreed commercial values blank.
The packet explicitly prohibits beginning work, invoicing, publishing, account changes, and external delivery before confirmation.
The access checklist requires role-specific, minimum-permission, revocable routes and prohibits shared raw credentials.
risks: The final interview or written terms may materially change the proposed scope.
Treating a historical job range as the trial rate would overstate agreed income.
